name: 24128-shortio-70b-8gpu
hardware: 8x H100 80GB HBM3, one whole a3 node (--gres=gpu:8), NVSwitch, driver 570.195.03.
parallelism: TP=8, PP=1, DP=1, EP off: one eight-rank tensor-parallel group. Part of the declaration -- do not shrink it to fit a smaller allocation.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=1024, bounded at 1024 requests / 2700 s safety. No warmup and no cooldown: one admission batch, every request inside the measured window.
workload: guidellm synthetic_text, single turn, no prefix_buckets. Prompt exactly 128 tokens and output exactly 128 (min = max = 128), ignore_eos forced, every prompt distinct.
purpose: A 70-billion-parameter chat assistant giving short fixed-length replies to 1024 concurrent users across one eight-GPU node.
launch:
# The engine's command line. Do not trade the model down for a smaller one.
model: RedHatAI/Meta-Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct-FP8

# Eight cards in ONE tensor-parallel group; no PP, no DP, no EP. Not a free parameter.
tensor-parallel-size: 8

# The checkpoint's own torch_dtype; float16 would cast every unquantised tensor away from it.
dtype: bfloat16

max-model-len: 2048

# NOT "the defaults": the async engine path resolves neither of these, so leaving them unset
# silently clamps the 1024-stream operating point. Both must stay written down.
max-num-seqs: 1024
max-num-batched-tokens: 16384

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90

# INLINE JSON, ON ONE LINE. The config reader skips indented lines, so re-flowing this into a
# block mapping drops the key and the engine starts at rc=0 on the default mode -- a silent
# wrong run.
compilation-config: {"cudagraph_mode": "FULL"}

disable-log-stats: true

# The engine's own default at this commit, written down. Every prompt is unique, so it cannot
# hit either way.
enable-prefix-caching: true

# kv-cache-dtype is deliberately unset: this checkpoint declares kv_cache_scheme null and ships
# no k_scale/v_scale, so an fp8 KV cache would run on unit scales and change numerics.
